profile_text.body:
Meta AI (FAIR) is a for-profit research lab headquartered in Menlo Park, California, USA. It also appears under the names FAIR, Meta FAIR, and Facebook AI Research. Its own research site presents work on Muse Spark, Muse Glimmer, and Muse Image, along with SAM 3 and open-source AI models, and it describes a new Meta Model API as part of the latest from Meta AI research.

The site frames this output as the latest from Meta AI research, with an emphasis on open-source model releases alongside the named Muse and SAM systems. No individual products are tracked for the company in the records available here, and no MCP servers are listed.

No specific lawsuits are named. Its legal exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281.
